text: Cervezas San Miguel is part of the Mahou San Miguel group, a drinks company described as family-owned and 100% Spanish.
short: San Miguel beer is a brand of Mahou San Miguel, a family-owned, 100% Spanish drinks company.

source.name: Malagaes: Mahou San Miguel reconoce a Antonio Banderas, al Ayuntamiento de Málaga, al Unicaja Baloncesto y a Manuel Villafaina
source.quote: Mahou San Miguel, compañía familiar de bebidas 100% española y líder del sector cervecero en nuestro país
source.note: English: 'Mahou San Miguel, a family-owned, 100% Spanish drinks company and leader of the beer sector in our country.'

additionalSources.name: Rio Ave FC: Cervezas San Miguel é o novo Premium Partner do Rio Ave FC
additionalSources.quote: Cervezas San Miguel, parte do grupo Mahou San Miguel, é o novo Premium Partner do Rio Ave Futebol Clube.
additionalSources.note: English: 'Cervezas San Miguel, part of the Mahou San Miguel group, is Rio Ave FC's new Premium Partner.'
